The ''' Pantora system''', also known as the '''Pantoran system''', contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]], and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the only two inhabitable worlds in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="T" />

==History==
A brief conflict erupted between the two [[Species/Legends|species]] living in the system, when the Pantoran [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] declared Orto Plutonia to be a protectorate of Pantora and the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] to be trespassing. After brief [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|battle]] and the Chairman's death, peace was settled between the two species, and the Pantorans withdrew from the ice planet.<ref name="T" />

Later in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Blockade of Pantora/Legends|blockaded]] Pantora in an apparent isolated action. This was secretly an attempt of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to get Pantora to join the Confederacy. The action failed, and the ambassador responsible was denounced in public by [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], the Trade Federation [[Senator/Legends|Senator]].<ref name="SOI">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref>
